reason: The submitted CIF is valid and symmetry-expands in I-43d (No. 220) to 40 fully occupied atoms, U12Cu12Sb16 (Z=4; reduced U3Cu3Sb4), with a=9.4644 A; primitive standardization gives the equivalent 20-atom Z=2 cell. All 25 observed reflections through 90 degrees are indexed by this cell with no important unindexed line. The instantiated rounded CIF gives a whole-profile RMS of 0.1307 (Rprofile 0.0406), essentially at the Pawley-like free-intensity bound of 0.1287; refinement converges to a=9.464416 A and Sb x=0.086261, matching the submitted 9.4644/0.0863 model. The only multiplicity-compatible ordering ambiguity, U/Cu exchange on 12a/12b, is quantitatively rejected (whole-profile RMS 0.613 versus 0.131 and grossly wrong major intensities). Full periodic neighbor shells show no overlaps or pervasive implausible contacts (shortest U-Cu 2.898 A, Cu-Sb 2.658 A, U-Sb 3.246 A), and bond-valence analysis yields a charge-neutral U(III)/Cu(I)/Sb(-III) assignment. No concrete diffraction-compatible incompatible realization survives, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
